razorpay_link_description: Razorpay payment links are URLs that you can send to patients through SMS and email to collect payments from them. Patients can click on the URL, which opens the payment request page, and complete the payment using any of the available payment methods.
notify_via_email_description: We will send you an email with the payment link.
notify_via_sms_description: We will send you an SMS with the payment link.
collect_payment_via_razorpay_qr_code: Collect payment via Razorpay QR code
razorpay_qr_code_description: Razorpay QR codes are QR codes that you can display in your facility to collect payments from patients. Patients can scan the QR code with their mobile device using a UPI app, which forwards them to a UPI flow.
configure_razorpay_account_description: Configure Razorpay account to enable payment collection through Razorpay.
razorpay_payment_confirmed: Payment confirmed and recorded against the invoice
razorpay_payment_partially_paid: A partial payment has been recorded; the balance is still pending
razorpay_payment_still_pending: Razorpay reports the payment is still pending
razorpay_payment_not_completed: Razorpay reports the payment did not complete ({{status}})
razorpay_qr_code_closed_unpaid: The QR code is closed and no payment was received
razorpay_gateway_unreachable: Could not get an answer from Razorpay, try again shortly
